name: Swampers
description: The people of the Swamp, often tied to no gang: outcasts, outlaws, exiles, and criminals in a violent, dog-eat-dog society where trivial insults start street fights. Five gangs, each under a Big Boss, run the region: the Hounds, the Blackshifters, the Grayflayers, the Stone Rats, and the Twinblades.
